intro.title: mask and clip-path
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a visually engaging webpage that uses CSS to reveal and hide parts of images in creative shapes. You will learn the core concepts of masking and clipping, which control the visible area of an element. The main technologies involved are the CSS properties `mask` and `clip-path`. As a beginner, you'll start with simple shapes and progress to more complex effects, all within a single CSS file. By the end, you'll be able to apply these properties to design unique visual compositions without altering the original image files.
intro.usecase: The mask and clip-path properties are essential for creating sophisticated visual effects in modern web interfaces. Developers use these techniques to create non-rectangular UI elements like circular profile images, custom-shaped buttons, and decorative image cutouts in dashboards and marketing sites. In e-commerce platforms, clip-path helps create visually appealing product image galleries with unique shapes, while masks are used for subtle image transitions and overlays in hero sections. These CSS properties allow designers to break away from traditional rectangular layouts, enabling more creative and engaging user experiences across applications.
